Sunday Morning Coffee Jam

Kapolei, HI

No-drop

Sunday Morning Coffee Jam is a road group ride in Kapolei, HI. It meets every Sunday, meet 7:00 am, roll 7:15 am, starting at Chili's parking lot, Kapolei. Expect about 35–40 miles, fast social group, no-drop, all abilities.

About the Sunday Morning Coffee Jam group ride

A west-side Oahu Sunday ride, 35 to 40 miles, that calls itself a fast social group but is no-drop and open to all abilities. Route map is on the HBL listing. Organized through a Facebook group.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
